speaker: richard_burbage
text: You are out of him. That is twice this week, and you have not made a poem of it, which I take as kindness.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am out. Egeon is a long wait and a short life on the stage. I am done with both for today.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The bill is walked. Nothing was bought. The K was not in this play, and I did not smuggle it in. Go home before someone asks you for a total you do not have.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody is getting a total. I am going home. I have a line to write for tomorrow, and it is not a column.
